rationale: The epoch day count produced by the 400-year era decomposition is the only input date::weekday takes, and it crosses into a modular domain where C++ truncating division forces a second, differently written formula, so the caller is correct only if the callee's two branches agree with mathematical modulo for every day count the era domain can produce.

minimum_scope.input_domain: year in [-32767, 32767], month in [1, 12], day in [1, 31], days::rep is a 32-bit int
